Delivery suite: customer, courier and dispatcher apps

Orders go to the nearest courier, customers track them on the map, and delivery times and courier pay are counted exactly. Qilich builds the MVP in 10–14 weeks, from UZS 215 mln; the full version in 20–32 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Customer ordering (app or Telegram)
  • Courier app with route and statuses
  • Dispatcher web panel with a live map
  • Delivery zones and fees
  • Cash and Click or Payme
What the full version adds
  • Automatic assignment and order batching
  • Courier shifts and payouts
  • Photo proof of delivery
  • Yandex Delivery as a fallback
  • Ratings
  • Delivery-time analytics by zone
  • Partner panel for restaurants or stores

What we need from you

  • App Store and Google Play accounts
  • Logo, colours and texts
  • One person who makes the decisions

Questions

What does “Delivery suite: customer, courier and dispatcher apps” cost?
